FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Each challenge has three nine-pin frames. Score the shown total pinfall target; each frame allows two deliveries and retains the actual standing pins for the second ball.
Choose offset, aim, launch speed and hook. A simulated moving ball and moving pins exchange impulses; hooks bend more near the far end of the lane. Fallen pins leave the next-ball rack.
Clear all three challenges for a finite campaign. A gutter/weak delivery uses its ball. Failing the three-frame quota ends the challenge. Reset challenge or Restart game restores the appropriate start.

Use Tab then Enter or Space on every named control; touch the same controls on mobile. Native sliders support arrows and touch dragging. All games are turn-paced: time advances only on the labeled simulation actions. Visual field interpretation is required.

Endless review

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Settle three fragile suspended loads into their receivers. Trolley acceleration drives a real modeled pendulum; rope length changes also alter its angular velocity.
Every motion/hoist action simulates 0.4s. Cancel sway with the timing of acceleration and braking. Read the payload’s velocity and the full obstacle geometry; its swept motion is checked.
Detach only within receiver radius 0.55, payload speed below 0.55 and angular speed below 0.24. Contact, unsafe detach or 140 beats loses. Reset challenge or Restart game restores the load.

Use Tab then Enter or Space on every named control; touch the same controls on mobile. Native sliders support arrows and touch dragging. All games are turn-paced: time advances only on the labeled simulation actions. Visual field interpretation is required.

Seeded receiver positions across three obstacle families change the required sway cancellation and rope length. Unsafe detach/contact ends the run.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Select a rigid solid and translate along one of its permitted axes. All occupied voxels must clear other solids and cabinet walls.

Extract every solid within the slide allowance. Three studies change blocking dependencies; Reset or Restart restores the cabinet.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Settle three fragile suspended loads into their receivers. Trolley acceleration drives a real modeled pendulum; rope length changes also alter its angular velocity.
Every motion/hoist action simulates 0.4s. Cancel sway with the timing of acceleration and braking. Read the payload’s velocity and the full obstacle geometry; its swept motion is checked.
Detach only within receiver radius 0.55, payload speed below 0.55 and angular speed below 0.24. Contact, unsafe detach or 140 beats loses. Reset challenge or Restart game restores the load.

Use Tab then Enter or Space on every named control; touch the same controls on mobile. Native sliders support arrows and touch dragging. All games are turn-paced: time advances only on the labeled simulation actions. Visual field interpretation is required.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Reach the three ordered air gates in each of three unpowered routes. Gates have visible position/radius and minimum height. Height is the only flight reserve.
Bank changes heading by 0.22rad and advances one beat. Thermals supply lift only within their radius. Best-glide trim minimizes sink; slow trim stays in lift longer, while fast trim spends height for distance.
Zero height, leaving the 0–21 by 0–20 corridor or 90 beats loses. Plan the path through lift before aiming for a distant gate. Reset challenge or Restart game retries.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Select a rigid solid and translate along one of its permitted axes. All occupied voxels must clear other solids and cabinet walls.
A withdraws through +X and B through +Y; when present, C uses the single +Z roof aperture. All occupied voxels must pass X ≥5, Y ≥5 or Z ≥3 respectively. A partly withdrawn piece remains a collision obstacle.
Extract every solid within the slide allowance. Three studies change blocking dependencies; Reset or Restart restores the cabinet.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

Endless review

Authored interlock dependencies are finite. Endless would require a checked inverse-assembly generator with genuinely different clearance orders.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Select a rigid solid and translate along one of its permitted axes. All occupied voxels must clear other solids and cabinet walls.
A withdraws through +X and B through +Y; when present, C uses the single +Z roof aperture. All occupied voxels must pass X ≥5, Y ≥5 or Z ≥3 respectively. A partly withdrawn piece remains a collision obstacle.
Extract every solid within the slide allowance. Three studies change blocking dependencies; Reset or Restart restores the cabinet.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

How to play

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Select a rigid solid and translate along one of its permitted axes. All occupied voxels must clear other solids and cabinet walls.
A withdraws through +X and B through +Y; when present, C uses the single +Z roof aperture. All occupied voxels must pass X ≥5, Y ≥5 or Z ≥3 respectively. A partly withdrawn piece remains a collision obstacle.
Extract every solid within the slide allowance. Three studies change blocking dependencies; Reset or Restart restores the cabinet.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

How to play
Inject a cavity cell only from the active gate or a neighboring filled cell. Each injection spends one resin unit.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Inject a cavity cell only from the active gate or a neighboring filled cell. Each injection spends one resin unit.
Every remaining connected gas pocket must reach an open vent. Filled open vents leak one additional resin unit on each later injection.
Fill the entire cavity, close all vents and cure. Trapped gas or depleted resin loses; three mold geometries and Reset/Restart are available.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Select a rigid solid and translate along one of its permitted axes. All occupied voxels must clear other solids and cabinet walls.
A withdraws through +X and B through +Y; when present, C uses the single +Z roof aperture. All occupied voxels must pass X ≥5, Y ≥5 or Z ≥3 respectively. A partly withdrawn piece remains a collision obstacle.
Extract every solid within the slide allowance. Three studies change blocking dependencies; Reset or Restart restores the cabinet.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

Endless review

Authored interlock dependencies are finite. Endless would require a checked inverse-assembly generator with genuinely different clearance orders.

FIELD GUIDE

How to play
Inject a cavity cell only from the active gate or a neighboring filled cell. Each injection spends one resin unit.
Every remaining connected gas pocket must reach an open vent. Filled open vents leak one additional resin unit on each later injection.
Fill the entire cavity, close all vents and cure. Trapped gas or depleted resin loses; three mold geometries and Reset/Restart are available.

Tap the labeled native controls, or use Tab with Enter/Space. All actions are turn-paced; dragging and timers are unnecessary. Reset study preserves prior clears; Restart returns to study one.

Endless review

The three molds are authored. A gas-safe cavity generator needs more topology validation before unlimited casting contracts.
